verdict.rationale: Postman docs confirm a spec-first design workflow via Spec Hub, letting users design an API's structure and check it against governance rules (postman-docs-16, postman-docs-22, postman-docs-38, postman-docs-54), but no evidence explicitly confirms exporting that spec as an OpenAPI file/format for external use. missing for 10: explicit documentation of OpenAPI export/download capability, independent corroboration of round-tripping specs to OpenAPI format.
